1.sahih_international: About what are they asking one another?
1.pickthall: Whereof do they question one another?
1.shakir: Of what do they ask one another?
1.arberry: Of what do they question one another?

2.muhammad_sarwar: They quarrel about the great news
2.mohsin_khan: About the great news, (i.e. Islamic Monotheism, the Quran, which Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) brought and the Day of Resurrection, etc.),

3.sahih_international: That over which they are in disagreement.
3.pickthall: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
3.mohsin_khan: About which they are in disagreement.

4.sahih_international: No! They are going to know.
4.pickthall: Nay, but they will come to know!
4.yusuf_ali: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
4.shakir: Nay! they shall soon come to know
4.muhammad_sarwar: (What they think is certainly despicable!). They will soon come to know (the reality).
4.mohsin_khan: Nay, they will come to know!
4.arberry: No indeed; they shall soon know!

5.sahih_international: Then, no! They are going to know.
5.pickthall: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
5.yusuf_ali: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
5.shakir: Nay! Nay! they shall soon know.
5.muhammad_sarwar: Yes, indeed, before long they will learn all about it.
5.mohsin_khan: Nay, again, they will come to know!
5.arberry: Again, no indeed; they shall soon know!

6.sahih_international: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
6.pickthall: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
6.yusuf_ali: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
6.shakir: Have We not made the earth an even expanse?
6.muhammad_sarwar: Have We not made the earth as a place to rest
6.mohsin_khan: Have We not made the earth as a bed,
6.arberry: Have We not made the earth as a cradle

7.muhammad_sarwar: and the mountains as pegs (to anchor the earth)?

8.sahih_international: And We created you in pairs
8.pickthall: And We have created you in pairs,
8.yusuf_ali: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
8.shakir: And We created you in pairs,
8.muhammad_sarwar: Have We not created you in pairs,
8.mohsin_khan: And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.).
8.arberry: And We created you in pairs,

9.sahih_international: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
9.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
9.yusuf_ali: And made your sleep for rest,
9.shakir: And We made your sleep to be rest (to you),
9.muhammad_sarwar: made sleep for you to rest,
9.mohsin_khan: And have made your sleep as a thing for rest.
9.arberry: and We appointed your sleep for a rest;

10.sahih_international: And made the night as clothing
10.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
10.yusuf_ali: And made the night as a covering,
10.shakir: And We made the night to be a covering,
10.muhammad_sarwar: made the night as a covering,
10.mohsin_khan: And have made the night as a covering (through its darkness),
10.arberry: and We appointed night for a garment,

11.sahih_international: And made the day for livelihood
11.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
11.yusuf_ali: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
11.shakir: And We made the day for seeking livelihood.
11.muhammad_sarwar: and the day as time for you to make a living?
11.mohsin_khan: And have made the day for livelihood.
11.arberry: and We appointed day for a livelihood.

12.sahih_international: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
12.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
12.yusuf_ali: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
12.shakir: And We made above you seven strong ones,
12.muhammad_sarwar: Have We not made seven strong heavens above you,
12.mohsin_khan: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
12.arberry: And We have built above you seven strong ones,

13.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
13.yusuf_ali: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
13.shakir: And We made a shining lamp,
13.mohsin_khan: And have made (therein) a shinning lamp (sun).
13.arberry: and We appointed a blazing lamp

14.sahih_international: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
14.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
14.yusuf_ali: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
14.shakir: And We send down from the clouds water pouring forth abundantly,
14.muhammad_sarwar: and sent down heavy rains from the clouds
14.mohsin_khan: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.
14.arberry: and have sent down out of the rainclouds water cascading

15.sahih_international: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
15.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
15.yusuf_ali: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
15.shakir: That We may bring forth thereby corn and herbs,
15.mohsin_khan: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,
15.arberry: that We may bring forth thereby grain and plants,

17.sahih_international: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
17.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
17.yusuf_ali: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
17.shakir: Surely the day of decision is (a day) appointed:
17.muhammad_sarwar: The Day of Judgment will certainly be the final appointment.
17.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
17.arberry: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,

18.sahih_international: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
18.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
18.yusuf_ali: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
18.shakir: The day on which the trumpet shall be blown so you shall come forth in hosts,
18.muhammad_sarwar: On that day the trumpet will be sounded and you will come (to Us) in huge groups.
18.mohsin_khan: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups);
18.arberry: the day the Trumpet is blown, and you shall come in troops,

19.sahih_international: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
19.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
19.yusuf_ali: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
19.shakir: And the heaven shall be opened so that it shall be all openings,
19.muhammad_sarwar: The heavens will have openings like doors.
19.mohsin_khan: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,
19.arberry: and heaven is opened, and become gates,

20.sahih_international: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
20.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
20.yusuf_ali: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
20.shakir: And the mountains shall be moved off so that they shall remain a mere semblance.
20.muhammad_sarwar: The mountains will be driven away and become like mirages.
20.mohsin_khan: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.
20.arberry: and the mountains are set in motion, and become a vapour.

21.sahih_international: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
21.yusuf_ali: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
21.muhammad_sarwar: Hell will lie in wait (for its prey).
21.mohsin_khan: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush,
21.arberry: Behold, Gehenna has become an ambush,

22.sahih_international: For the transgressors, a place of return,
22.yusuf_ali: For the transgressors a place of destination:
22.shakir: A place of resort for the inordinate,
22.muhammad_sarwar: It will be a place of return
22.mohsin_khan: A dwelling place for the Taghun (those who transgress the boundry limits set by Allah like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals, etc.),

23.sahih_international: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
23.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.
23.yusuf_ali: They will dwell therein for ages.
23.muhammad_sarwar: for the rebellious ones and they will live therein for ages.
23.mohsin_khan: They will abide therein for ages,

24.sahih_international: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
24.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
24.yusuf_ali: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
24.shakir: They shall not taste therein cool nor drink
24.muhammad_sarwar: They will not feel cold nor taste any drink
24.mohsin_khan: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.
24.arberry: tasting therein neither coolness nor any drink

25.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
25.yusuf_ali: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
25.shakir: But boiling and intensely cold water,
25.mohsin_khan: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges.

26.muhammad_sarwar: as a fitting recompense for their deeds.
26.mohsin_khan: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

27.sahih_international: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
27.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
27.yusuf_ali: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
27.shakir: Surely they feared not the account,
27.muhammad_sarwar: They did not expect such a Judgment
27.mohsin_khan: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.
27.arberry: They indeed hoped not for a reckoning,

28.sahih_international: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
28.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
28.yusuf_ali: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
28.shakir: And called Our communications a lie, giving the lie (to the truth).
28.mohsin_khan: But they belied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet (Peace be upon him) brought) completely.
28.arberry: and they cried loud lies to Our signs;

29.sahih_international: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
29.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
29.yusuf_ali: And all things have We preserved on record.
29.shakir: And We have recorded everything in a book,
29.muhammad_sarwar: However, We have recorded everything in a book.
29.mohsin_khan: And all things We have recorded in a Book.
29.arberry: and everything We have numbered in a Book.

30.sahih_international: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
30.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
30.yusuf_ali: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
30.shakir: So taste! for We will not add to you aught but chastisement.
30.muhammad_sarwar: (They will be told), "Suffer, We shall only increase the torment for you".
30.mohsin_khan: So taste you (the results of your evil actions); no increase shall We give you, except in torment.
30.arberry: 'Taste! We shall increase you not save in chastisement.'

31.sahih_international: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
31.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
31.yusuf_ali: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
31.shakir: Surely for those who guard (against evil) is achievement,
31.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones will be triumphant.
31.mohsin_khan: Verily, for the Muttaqun, there will be a success (Paradise);
31.arberry: Surely for the godfearing awaits a place of security,

32.muhammad_sarwar: They will have gardens and vineyards,

33.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age;
33.yusuf_ali: And voluptuous women of equal age;
33.shakir: And voluptuous women of equal age;
33.muhammad_sarwar: maidens with pears-shaped breasts who are of equal age (to their spouses)
33.mohsin_khan: And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age;
33.arberry: and maidens with swelling breasts, like of age,

34.yusuf_ali: And a cup full (to the brim).

35.sahih_international: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
35.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
35.yusuf_ali: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
35.shakir: They shall not hear therein any vain words nor lying.
35.muhammad_sarwar: They will not hear therein any unnecessary words or lies.
35.mohsin_khan: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;
35.arberry: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cry of lies,

36.sahih_international: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
36.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
36.yusuf_ali: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
36.shakir: A reward from your Lord, a gift according to a reckoning:
36.muhammad_sarwar: This will be their reward from your Lord, a favor from Him and a recompense for their deeds.
36.mohsin_khan: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds).
36.arberry: for a recompense from thy Lord, a gift, a reckoning,

37.sahih_international: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
37.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
37.yusuf_ali: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
37.shakir: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Beneficent Allah, they shall not be able to address Him.
37.muhammad_sarwar: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He is the Beneficent God and no one will be able to address Him.
37.mohsin_khan: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Beneficent, none can dare to speak with Him (on the Day of Resurrection except after His Leave).
37.arberry: Lord of the heavens and earth, and all that between them is, the All-merciful of whom they have no power to speak.

38.sahih_international: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
38.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
38.yusuf_ali: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
38.shakir: The day on which the spirit and the angels shall stand in ranks; they shall not speak except he whom the Beneficent Allah permits and who speaks the right thing.
38.muhammad_sarwar: On that day, the Spirit and the angels who stand in lines will not speak except those whom the Beneficent God has permitted, and he will speak the right words.
38.mohsin_khan: The Day that Ar-Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, none shall speak except him whom the Most Beneficent (Allah) allows, and he will speak what is right.
38.arberry: Upon the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in ranks they shall speak not, save him to whom the All-merciful has given leave, and who speaks aright.

39.sahih_international: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
39.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
39.yusuf_ali: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
39.shakir: That is the sure day, so whoever desires may take refuge with his Lord.
39.muhammad_sarwar: That will be the Day of the Truth. So let those who want seek refuge from their Lord.
39.mohsin_khan: That is without doubt the True Day, so, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!
39.arberry: That is the true day; so whosoever wills takes unto his Lord a resort.

40.sahih_international: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
40.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
40.yusuf_ali: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
40.shakir: Surely We have warned you of a chastisement near at hand: the day when man shall see what his two hands have sent before, and the unbeliever shall say: O! would that I were dust!
40.muhammad_sarwar: We have warned you of the approaching torment. On that day, a person will see what his hands have committed. A disbeliever will say, "Would that I had been dust".
40.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment, the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"
40.arberry: Lo, We have warned you of a nigh chastisement, upon the day when a man shall behold what his hands have forwarded, and the unbeliever shall say, 'O would that I were dust!'
